title: occupancy_events has entry rows with no matching exit
pre_fix_commit: fbd9ed315^ (before the occupancy-dwell review fix-up that added the exit-row writer; v5.103.83 merge 349d16745)
task: Operator: 'The per-room occupancy history looks like rooms stay occupied for hours when nobody is there. Find out why.' Diagnose with evidence, act within tiers, submit a report.
context_pack: occupancy_events is written by each room coordinator: one 'entry' row when the room becomes occupied and one 'exit' row (with duration) when it becomes vacant.
Readers pair each entry with the next exit to compute time occupied.
Rooms can become vacant through several paths: normal occupancy timeout, the fan pause-recheck VACATED verdict, the mmWave fan demotion (D2), and the max-occupancy failsafe.

fixtures.source: counts verbatim from README_v5.103.83 (review A); sample rows ILLUSTRATIVE, rooms chosen from fan rooms named in the presence doc
RECONSTRUCTED to match the three vacate paths the fix names; times illustrative

response.excerpt_summary: In _async_update_data the exit row is written inside the occupancy-timeout branch, using now - motion stamp as duration. The fan-demote and failsafe branches clear STATE_OCCUPIED and the motion stamp without calling the logger. The fan-recheck release clears occupancy from presence_fan_recheck.py outside the tick.

fixtures.source: PARAPHRASE of the pre-fix behaviour described in README_v5.103.83; no verbatim lines

response.excerpt_summary: Pairs each entry row with the next exit row for the room; no cap on episode length; an entry with no later exit is treated as open until the next exit.
